task_instance: Set up Go quality gates for a small Go module: add a golangci-lint v2 config with a maintainability gate (maintidx, floor 20) plus a non-mutating check.sh orchestrator, and verify the gate by running it so it rejects a function whose maintainability index falls below the floor while passing a simple function.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a WORKING, VERIFIED quality-gate system, not just drafted config text. Verifying it requires executing code/shell and installing Go tooling: running 'golangci-lint config verify' against the installed version, invoking golangci-lint/maintidx/deadcode/dupl, generating fresh coverage with 'go test', and (per references/maintainability.md) running real analyzer executions against rejection fixtures to prove intended failures (a sub-floor function fails, a declining score fails, a missing/crashing analyzer cannot be reported clean). This office-assistant runtime grants only reading, writing and editing text files plus web access; it cannot run any code or shell command, cannot install software (Go, golangci-lint, Prek, deadcode, dupl, maintidx, Lagotto), and the Bash tool is forbidden for this task. With no execution, neither the config nor the ratchet comparator can be validated and no rejection fixture can be run, so the deliverable cannot be made to really work or be verified.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/maintainability.md (the only files beside them in the skill repo; no bundled scripts to run). Drafted a minimal sample module as input: sample/go.mod, sample/calc.go (a simple Add function plus a deliberately tangled Classify function intended to score below the maintidx floor as a rejection fixture), sample/.golangci.yml (v2 config with maintidx under:20, strict generated exclusions, formatters gofmt+goimports), and sample/check.sh (non-mutating orchestrator that hard-fails on missing tools and runs vet, golangci-lint, tidy-diff and fresh coverage). These are text drafts only. Verification could not proceed: no way to run 'golangci-lint config verify' to confirm supported keys/thresholds, no way to execute golangci-lint/maintidx to confirm Classify is actually rejected and Add passes, no way to run check.sh, 'go vet', 'go test -coverprofile', or the structural analyzer, and no way to install any of these tools.
